phases.dev: One attempt only after frozen source/roles/protocol, unmocked source/asset/version preflight, exact independent remote source readback and actual exclusive scoped lock. Require3/3 fixed exposed engineering canaries before first new source-case materialization. No retry.
phases.confirmation: One attempt only if independent all-class/accuracy/proper DEV gates AND frozen conservative whole-pipeline runtime forecast pass. Same exact FP32 model/tokenizer; own3/3 canaries again. Exact reserved project-prediction/label-unused24, no fitting/selection on labels.

runtime_forecast: 24*max_DEV(document_elapsed_seconds/3)*max(1,CONF_max_source_units/DEV_max_source_units)+2*whole_pipeline_initialization_seconds+60<=600. Whole initialization includes launcher entry, imports, source/asset checks, model/canaries, lazy projection, BGE and capacity tokenization.
cleanup: Durable reservation and pre-Popen intent consume the phase slot. Retain exact owned PID/start_ticks/PGID; TERM/KILL only that owned group and finish before600. Partial/error/semantic rejection closes all remaining slots. Final Git publication/readback precedes physical lock release.
confirmation_capacity: Only exact previously published input-only text tokenization under fixed identity, zero neural/native predictions and zero annotation choices; disclose separately from confirmation inference/gold use.
claim_scope: Licensed ContractNLI transfer diagnostic with matched same-reader native/lexical/positional evidence arms. No official JevBench, full LegalBench or ClaimBench placement.
